address: 3 rue de la Gare, Sillery, 51500, France
bio: This elegant inn, a post house in a former life, sports a terrace overlooking the River Vesle. The setting is bucolic, the food classical: sea bass meunière, baby artichokes and confit tomatoes, and a Grand Marnier soufflé. The impressive wine cellar is very competitively priced!...
